boundary.description: From Smithy Bridge Railway station, E along Smithy Bridge Road and in a straight line across Hollingworth Lake to M62 Motorway near Lower Booth Hollins Farm. Then E along M62 Rochdale – Calderdale District boundary. Then S by the diocesan boundary to the junction of Ripponden Road (A672) and Buckstones Road (B6197) at Grains Bar. NW along Buckstones Road to Brunchapel Farm, then N by a beeline to the W boundary of the Brushes Clough Reservoir and by a stream following into it from the west to the point opposite Golden Street, then by a bee-line to the junction of Dunwoods Park Courst and Milnrow Road, N along Milnrow Road (Shaw Road, NewHey Road, Elizabethan Way to M62 junction 21, and W along the Motorway and Road A6193 to its junction with Kingsway), the N along Moss Bridge Road, Channing Street, Church Road, to the Rochdale – Smithy Bridge railway and E along that railway to Smithy Bridge station.
